# Pinned Native Contract Fixtures

The seven files below plesk/extension are exact source bytes identified in UPSTREAM.json, used only for offline bridge/collector contracts. They are not an installed Plesk SDK, production distribution or native Linux/Windows certification. WHMCS ZIPs exclude this directory.

H4DU_PLESK_SOURCE selects an identified native source checkout for PHP bridge/Process tests. The Python report helper uses the pinned collector. Selection is a developer test control, not a browser field or WHMCS setting.
